subject: Boost CSAT and agent productivity
body:
I noticed Salesforce's record FY26 Q2 results and thought these CX implications might matter. With stronger Subscription & Support revenue, there’s clearer capacity for product and support investments that map to CSAT, NPS and contact‑center improvements.

- Record Q2 growth increases vendor investment capacity — review roadmap visibility for contact center and self‑service rollouts.
- Zero Copy Partner Network enables secure, bidirectional zero‑copy integrations to create an omnichannel customer profile and help improve first‑contact resolution.
- Agentforce conversational AI provides APIs to pilot assistants that deflect routine queries, boost agent productivity and expand self‑service.

If helpful, I can send a one‑page summary mapping these options to measurable CSAT/NPS levers, continue via email, or share a short pilot outline.
